question: Does the conformance and acceptance oracle validly and reliably measure what it claims?
pass_criterion: oracle distinguishes known-good from known-bad references; mutation/sanity tests detect seeded defects; adequate inter-rater agreement for manual rules and criteria
required_evidence: populated TASK_RULE_MATRIX and TASK_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX; oracle_result and acceptance_result artifacts; mutation tests
notes: addresses v1 missing acceptance oracle and constant layer_jaccard; dependency-direction reference checker + synthetic fixtures implemented (necessary not sufficient for G1); pilot task candidates authored with hidden manifests in a separate private evaluator repo (status review; not frozen); task-specific oracle validity + hidden-acceptance validation remain open

question: Do the tasks and reset checkpoints discriminate between conditions without floor/ceiling saturation?
pass_criterion: pilot shows non-degenerate variation across conditions and reset states; checkpoints leave meaningful post-reset work
required_evidence: pilot runs (paid; NOT part of this work package); dispersion and ceiling checks
notes: guards against saturated metrics (v1 ci_pass all True); condition-neutral checkpoints (TD-B01); interaction-focused power simulation before the core grid (TD-B20); pilot task candidates + draft condition-neutral reset checkpoints authored; discrimination untested (no pilot run)

question: Is there a direct AFCI effect on a direct conformance or completeness outcome (C4 vs C1)?
pass_criterion: pre-registered confirmatory contrast per the SAP with multiplicity-corrected inference and a reported effect size with 95% CI
required_evidence: frozen result set; SAP-specified model fit
notes: thresholds not derived from v1 (TD-B07); single primary endpoint = architecture-violation rate (D8); rule satisfaction is descriptive; interaction power simulation (TD-B20)

question: Does the AFCI effect persist against the token-matched generic-guidance placebo (C4 vs C2)?
pass_criterion: verified C2/C4 token match within tolerance AND a confirmatory C4-vs-C2 contrast
required_evidence: recorded token counts per run; SAP contrast
notes: isolates architecture content from token volume

question: What is the C4-vs-C3 relationship with MAD content held byte-identical (equivalence allowed)?
pass_criterion: equivalence-aware C4-vs-C3 contrast with byte-identical MAD content verified (superiority equivalence or inferiority all valid)
notes: isolates delivery channel; C3 approx C4 is a valid supported outcome (D4)

question: Is the architecture guard validated (alias-aware; precision and recall; mutation tests)?
pass_criterion: precision and recall meet a pre-registered bar on a labelled corpus; seeded @afci-bench/* alias and barrel-laundered violations are detected; known-good diverse solutions are not flagged
required_evidence: labelled violation/clean corpus (seeded incl alias/barrel-laundered); alias+barrel+re-export resolution; moved/deleted-code + full-repository (not added-line-only) evaluation; known-good diverse-solution specificity; legitimate alternatives frozen before confirmatory data; blinded double rating >=0.70 for manual rules; guard_result artifacts; mutation tests
notes: v1 guard matched literal libs/* and was blind to @afci-bench/* aliases (total=0); v2 oracle implements alias/barrel/re-export + moved/deleted + full-repo eval with synthetic fixtures; labelled corpus + mutation + inter-rater pending

question: Are the objective FGC measures available sufficient and confound-audited?
pass_criterion: INDUSTRIAL_DATA_AUDIT cleared - raw records accessible; minimum interpretable sample met; confounders auditable; anonymized
required_evidence: raw FGC records; confound audit; anonymization pipeline
notes: no invented FGC counts or dates; perception (CL12) reported separately

question: Before any claim is marked supported does each have its direct metric and evidence with no over-claim?
pass_criterion: every promoted claim has its required evidence; no claim marked supported without it; architectural integrity (CON-AI) not claimed as directly measured
